overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long FLY Daily ETF (FLYT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Firefly Aerospace Inc. stock (FLY) FLYT was launched on Oct 22, 2025 and is issued by Tradr.
